summary_lines: MAJOR renmark/agency.py:253 replaces the existing canonical delivery aggregate with default state, discarding run, work-package, source, and provenance data at the Agency-to-Orchestrator transition.
MAJOR renmark/agency.py:257 marks independent review approved solely from owner approval; this fabricates a review outcome and can incorrectly satisfy downstream readiness consumers.
Coverage only asserts milestone ID after auto-handoff; it does not prove preservation, rejection for inactive/unapproved states, handoff fields, or lifecycle summary read-only behavior.
dependency_notes: No recursion observed. The behavior fixture calls the transition twice because activate now auto-handoffs; it is idempotent only because each call reconstructs default state, which is the data-loss defect above.
